# UX & Behavior Requirements Checklist: Reset View Button

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the Reset view button: whether the reset target, state preservation, control placement and accessibility are complete, clear, consistent and measurable. For PR review of spec.md and plan.md.
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the starting view defined for every startup outcome: location found right away, found after a delay, denied, unsupported, and errored first and then found later? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK002 Is the full list of state that must stay unchanged after a reset given in one place, and does it cover the destination marker and the "Waiting for your location…" status shown before a route is computed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK003 Do the requirements say what the button looks like (text, icon or both) and, if it is an icon, which icon and which text alternative? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK004 Are hover, focus, active and disabled states specified for the control, or explicitly inherited from the zoom buttons? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK005 Do the requirements say whether a reset is announced to screen-reader users, given that FR-005 forbids changing the status message? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK006 Is a tooltip or other visible hint required for mouse users when the control shows only an icon? [Gap, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "at startup" / "when the app opened" bounded by an event or a time limit, so it is clear whether a location fix arriving after 30 s still replaces the starting view? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Clarifications] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK008 Is "next to the other map controls" defined with a corner or position relative to the zoom buttons? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §US2-1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK009 Is "starting center within a few meters" quantified with a number of meters? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK010 Is "visible glitch" defined clearly enough to be judged objectively (e.g. no flicker, no tile reload, no zoom bounce)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK011 Is "finishes moving within 1 second" measured from the press to the end of the animation, and does it include loading map tiles? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK012 Is "small screens" defined with a breakpoint or a minimum viewport size? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Does the plan's move of the zoom control from top-left to bottom-right agree with the spec, which only adds a button and does not mention moving existing controls? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Summary] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK014 Does FR-007 ("with the other map controls") fit the current layout, where the search panel already hides the default zoom control? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Research §R4] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK015 Is the edge case "button pressed while routes are loading: the map still goes to the starting view" consistent with the existing behavior where the map fits the routes once they arrive, possibly undoing the reset? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Design Notes 2] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK016 Is the zoom 15 used for the location-centered starting view clearly separate from the zoom 15 used when showing a destination before the location is known, so the second is never treated as a starting view? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK017 Do US1-4 ("located when the app opened") and the edge case "location arrives after the user has already moved the map" describe the same rule? [Consistency, Spec §US1-4, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Completeness (follow-up run, 2026-11-10)

- [x] CHK031 Does FR-011 define when "routes are loading" starts and ends (from the destination choice until routes are drawn, or until a failure / "No route found" status), so a reviewer can tell whether a given press falls inside the window? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-011] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK032 Do the requirements say whether a reset pressed while a route is "Waiting for your location…" still wins once the first fix arrives and the routes are computed, or whether the auto-centering and route fit both apply then? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK033 Is it specified whether a travel-mode change made after a reset counts as a "later route search" under FR-011, and so zooms the map to its routes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK034 Do the requirements bound the search/route panel's height (or how it scrolls) so FR-007's "MUST NOT overlap the search/route panel" can hold at 320 px wide, where the panel spans almost the full width and a long results or routes list could reach the bottom-right controls? [Gap, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK035 Is a minimum viewport height, or landscape orientation (e.g. 568×320), covered by the placement requirements, given that FR-007 and the Edge Cases only state a minimum width? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK036 Do the requirements state that the moved zoom buttons keep their current behavior, accessible names and tooltips, and keep working with the keyboard after the move to bottom-right? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Consistency (follow-up run, 2026-11-10)

- [x] CHK037 Are FR-001 ("the same size as the zoom buttons") and FR-009 ("at least 30×30 CSS px") consistent when the zoom buttons render smaller (Leaflet's 26 px non-touch size), and is it stated which rule wins? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-009] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK038 Is the asymmetry deliberate and stated: a reset pressed during route loading wins over the route fit (FR-011), but a reset pressed before the first location fix is overridden when the app centers on that fix (Edge Cases)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK039 Does the contract's "center equal to the starting view within floating-point tolerance" agree with SC-002's 5-meter tolerance, and is it clear which one is the acceptance bar? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, Contract reset-view-control §Guarantees] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK040 Does FR-008's "no shift of the view" when already at the starting view stay consistent with SC-002's 5-meter tolerance (does a sub-5 m correction count as a shift)? [Consistency, Measurability, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK041 Is the FR-005 unchanged-state list the same set as the one in SC-004 and the contract's "Guarantees after a press", or is it stated that FR-005 is the reference list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-004, Contract reset-view-control §Guarantees] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK042 Is the internal write `resetRouteSeq = routeSeq` (plan/data model) reconciled with FR-005's "MUST NOT change any other app state"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §resetRouteSeq] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Clarity (third run, 2026-11-10: narrow-screen panel cap)

- [x] CHK051 Is "viewports where the search/route panel and the bottom-right controls share the same horizontal space" given as a width the spec itself states, so a reviewer can judge it without the plan's estimate (~420 px; contract "≤ 440 px")? - [x] CHK052 Is "the panel always ends above the Reset view button" quantified with a minimum clearance (the plan assumes ≥ 10 px), so "touching" vs. "above" can be judged objectively? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Design Notes 4] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [ ] CHK053 Does FR-007 say what scrolls inside the capped panel: only the results and routes lists, or the whole panel content, including the search form, travel mode and status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK054 Is the "100%" height the panel cap is measured against defined (layout viewport vs. visible area), for mobile browsers where the on-screen keyboard or browser toolbars change the visible height while the search input has focus? ## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage (third run, 2026-11-10: narrow-screen panel cap)

- [ ] CHK055 Do the requirements say whether the status message (e.g. "Waiting for your location…", "Routing failed…") must stay visible when the capped panel is scrolled? It sits after the lists and could be scrolled out of view on narrow screens. [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK056 Is a minimum amount of panel content required to stay visible without scrolling at the smallest covered viewport (e.g. the search input, the Go button and the travel mode at 320×320, where the plan leaves only ~148 px)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Design Notes 4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Defaults used (no interaction possible): depth Standard; audience PR reviewer; focus = reset target & state behavior, control UX/accessibility/placement
- Follow-up run (CHK031–CHK050), defaults used (no interaction possible): depth Standard; audience PR reviewer; focus = requirements added after the first run (FR-007 zoom move, FR-009 size, FR-010 reduced motion, FR-011 reset vs. route fit) and spec/plan/contract consistency
- Third run (CHK051–CHK062), defaults used (no interaction possible): depth Standard; audience PR reviewer; focus = the narrow-screen panel height cap added to FR-007 (threshold, clearance, scrolling content, status visibility, short viewports) and how it interacts with reset (FR-005) and accessibility
